citation.title: From Paper to Pixels—A Narrative Review of Occlusal Analysis
citation.authors: May Aljanahi, Gerry Mckenna, Keyvan Moharamzadeh, Haitham Elbishari

s_design.evidence_quote: A Narrative Review of Occlusal Analysis

domains.note: Sections 2 and 5 and the declarations report no registered review protocol or registration identifier.

domains.evidence_quote: A literature search was conducted using PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Google
domains.note: Section 2 names at least two databases, search dates, terms and reference screening. The complete database-specific search strings are not reported.

Section 2 gives eligibility and exclusion criteria but no screening counts from records screened through full texts assessed to studies included. No individual list with reasons appears in Section 2, Sections 3–5 or the back matter.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: Section 2 describes selection and synthesis. Sections 3–5 discuss studies and limitations but report no method or results of risk-of-bias appraisal applied to the included studies.
Sections 2–5 report narrative synthesis and comparisons. No pooled estimates, statistical synthesis model or heterogeneity method is described.
Sections 2 and 5 describe searching and limitations. No publication-bias assessment, funnel plot or small-study effects procedure is reported.

penalties.evidence_quote: Conflicts of Interest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
penalties.note: The authors disclose no conflicts and report no specific funding.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome requires
penalties.note: The review calls for longitudinal validation and does not report a survival or success estimate based on inadequate follow-up.

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این منبع ۵ از ۱۰۰ و در باند E برای سؤال تشخیصی (DIAGNOSTIC) است.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور روایی کاربرد ابزارهای متداول و دیجیتال را در تحلیل اکلوژن توضیح می‌دهد. برای شناخت خروجی و محدودیت هر ابزار ارزش آموزشی دارد. اعتبار بالینی درازمدت و اثر استفاده بر پیامدهای بیمار یا پروتز به پژوهش طولی نیاز دارد.
